$comment: THE ENFORCEMENT SCOPE FOR THE A2 SHAPE RULE (Spec 122 §5.1).
Zero steps are converted today, so the shape rule CANNOT be enforced over
manifest.chains[*].file — every one of those 27 files would fail. This list is
the blocking scope: a file appears here only once its conversion has landed, and
each C-track pilot appends exactly one entry as its final commit.
The unconverted remainder is still SCANNED, in report-only mode, by
scripts/hooks/check-step-shape.sh --report-only. That report is the prove-red:
src/tests/step-conformance.infra.test.ts asserts the rule fires on every
manifest sources file NOT in this list, so an empty list is never a vacuous pass.
Paths are repo-root-relative and MUST each be a manifest.chains[*] step file.
The conformance suite enforces converted ⊆ manifest files, no duplicates, and
loaded.length === converted.length (the silent-import-death guard, Spec 122 §5.2).
PENDING ENTRIES (R-K.1, 2026-08-29; five-value vocabulary widened at pilot 9's
two 2026-09-04 commits — descriptor-lands-first landed, then step-validate.mjs
hard-stop-gating landed as its own commit, Spec 124 R-K amendment): each entry
is {file, registers_at, reason, declared, stage}. stage is closed-vocabulary:
"red_suite" | "descriptor_only" | "compute_ported" | "runner_wired" |
"shape_clean". red_suite = the per-step violations.test.ts (with it.fails()
call sites) has landed but the sibling <slug>.descriptor.json does NOT exist
yet — the file MAY still be shape-dirty (still calls pipeline.run()).
descriptor_only = the descriptor exists and independently validates against
step.schema.json (scripts/lib/step/validate.js validateDescriptor), but the
step's own compute/runner have not yet landed — conformanceFindings() is NOT
expected to return [] at this stage (module.exports.compute is still absent
on the shell). compute_ported/runner_wired are the two later partial stages
(compute module ported; shell frozen onto pipeline.step()) — declared in the
vocabulary for the commit that first needs them, not yet exercised by any
live entry. shape_clean = the descriptor exists AND
scripts/lib/step/validate.js's conformanceFindings() returns [] for it (compute
wired, shell frozen), but converted.json registration is deferred to the
cutover commit. The middle values exist because pilot 9 (ENRICHER, the first
archetype to split its own commit 7 into 7a schema / 7b descriptor / 7c compute
/ 7d runner / 7e golden-gate sub-commits, per the operator's own dispatch) is
the FIRST pending file whose descriptor genuinely lands before its compute —
every earlier pilot landed descriptor+compute+runner in one commit, so
red_suite -> shape_clean was always a single atomic jump and the middle states
were never observable. A pending entry whose descriptor exists while stage
stays "red_suite" is RED ("stage not advanced") — src/tests/
step-conformance.infra.test.ts enforces this (R-K.1's own concern: does the
declared stage match the artifact state on disk). SEPARATELY, `stage` also
gates scripts/analysis/step-validate.mjs's own G7/G8/G9 + Rules 4/11/12
hard-stop set (Spec 124 R-K amendment) — descriptor_only excludes
G7/G8/G9+Rules 4/11/12, compute_ported excludes G8/G9, runner_wired excludes
G9 only; the excluded row's score/status is UNCHANGED, only hardStop and its
own detail/note text ("— stage-gated (<stage>)") reflect the exclusion — see
step-validate.mjs's stageExclusions/aggregateHardStop and their selfTest()
locks. step-validate.mjs's fast invariant #5 (it.fails( call sites must sit
under a declared pending slug) keys on ANY of the five stages.
